bio.text: According to the legislative biography, Garner Shimizu represents House District 32 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and has lived in the district since the third grade.
The biography says he attended Moanalua Elementary, Intermediate and High Schools and graduated from the University of Hawaii with a mechanical engineering degree.
It says he became the owner of a sheet metal company and, once retired, became a Neighborhood Security Watch captain and a board member of the Moanalua Valley Community Association.
